We are going to examine the palmer penguins data from SOURCE

I am interested in finding out which penguin species and from which island have the longest average flipper length (cm)

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Import the required libraries
import pandas as pd
from palmerpenguins import load_penguins

# Load the penguins dataset
penguins = load_penguins()

# Clean up the dataset and prep for summarizing and visualizing
## Drop `NaNs` from the flipper_length_mm column (the variable we are interested in) 
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm'])
## Create a new column: flipper_length_cm (converting mm to cm)
penguins_clean['flipper_length_cm'] = penguins_clean['flipper_length_mm']/100

# Print the first 6 lines of the tidy penguins dataset
print(penguins_clean.head())
```

Summarise the mean flipper length by penguin species and island.

```{python}
#| echo: true
penguins_summary = (
    penguins_clean
    .loc[:,['species','island','flipper_length_cm']]
    .groupby(['species','island'])
    .mean()
    .sort_values(by='flipper_length_cm',ascending=False)
    .reset_index()
)
print(penguins_summary.head())
```
